Logos S3 aura slows enemy-source speed-driven projectiles only; overlapping auras use strongest minimum scale. Fixed-time movers remain unaffected until their native movement-adjustable dispatcher is recovered, and native/default projectile wall-clock lifetime is not extended.

Logos S3 ordinary end uses original Skill_3_End OnAttack.333 to remove eligible projectiles and interrupt aura, with full1.167 animation lock. Native ON_ABILITY_SPELL_ON versus OnAttack interruption/elimination ordering is unrecovered; a controlled/removed source interrupts aura without an end attack.

Logos T1 native randomDelayToBorn .3000000119 is bridged by a seeded uniform [0,.3] birth delay; exact native Unity distribution/clock is unrecovered. Pending emitted talent birth and cached talent ATK remain independent from subsequent owner withdrawal.
